transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to get the power-management plan sorted for tomorrow's 0800 to 1400 window. We have three two-hour blocks available: 0800-1000, 1000-1200, and 1200-1400. The facilities shop, clinic, and protected-network section all need an approved block or operating control before the period begins. Let's hear from each section on their requirements so we can put together a plan for my approval.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Col. Harper, I need to flag something before we proceed. I confirmed this morning that the east distribution panel must be taken offline for the generator load test from exactly 0800 to 1000. The electrical contractor's signed work sheet is in the facilities binder, but it hasn't been added to the coordination-board slide yet. This means the 0800-1000 block is already committed for the facilities shop.

transcript.text: Col. Harper, I need to add a clinic requirement to the plan. I confirmed with our pharmacy technician that the clinic's vaccine refrigerator must remain on generator-backed power during the exact 1000-1200 block while its primary feed is transferred. This pharmacy note was received after yesterday's clinic report and is not yet in the base power plan, so we need to ensure the 1000-1200 block accounts for this clinic requirement.
